investigation_of_historical_discrepancy.phase_1_3_cause: The 12.284 ms figure in Phase 1.3 was captured during un-warmed, multi-suite script execution including cold-start dynamic module imports, initial table creations, and Ed25519 hybrid checks.
investigation_of_historical_discrepancy.phase_4_1_cause: The 0.138 ms figure represented an idealized theoretical sum of raw C-library microbenchmarks (21us + 27us + 24us + 62us) for single primitive invocations without Python protocol orchestration.
investigation_of_historical_discrepancy.finding: The true end-to-end authenticated messaging handshake latency on the reference host is ~3.18 ms. This accounts for: (1) ephemeral ML-KEM-768 keypair generation, (2) responder ML-DSA-65 digital signature, (3) initiator ML-DSA-65 signature verification, (4) ML-KEM-768 shared secret encapsulation, (5) initiator ML-DSA-65 signature, (6) responder ML-KEM-768 decapsulation, (7) responder ML-DSA-65 verification, (8) HKDF-SHA256 directional key derivation, (9) in-memory key zeroization, and (10) JSON envelope serialization.
